notes: B-62 (2026-10-29), from the FDN round-1 verifier's failing pack: Obliterating Bolt 'deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.' Ajani, Caller of the Pride (printed loyalty 4) takes 4 damage, so it loses 4 loyalty (CR 120.3c) and the zero-loyalty state-based action would put it into the graveyard (CR 704.5i). That is dying (CR 700.4), so the replacement exiles it instead. Before the fix the zero-loyalty SBA moved the walker without consulting the dies replacements, and it landed in the graveyard.
